description: Add POST /api/v1/assets/batch-get-signed-urls endpoint accepting array of 100+ asset IDs, returning all signed URLs in single response. Add PATCH /api/v1/assets/batch-update supporting bulk favorite/tag operations. Current implementation requires N separate requests (100 assets = 100 PUT requests with 100 JWT validations and 100 database transactions). Batch endpoint: 1 request, 1 validation, 1 transaction.
